questions.question: What is the area of Earth where water movement and storage occurs?
questions.fact: The hydrosphere is the area of Earth where water movement and storage occurs.
questions.explanation: The hydrosphere is the area of Earth where water movement and storage occurs.

questions.question: What is phosphorus a major component of?
questions.fact: Phosphorus is a major component of nucleic acids.

questions.question: What do artificial fertilizers used in agriculture have environmental impacts on?
questions.fact: Artificial fertilizers used in agriculture have environmental impacts on surface water.
questions.explanation: Artificial fertilizers used in agriculture have environmental impacts on surface water.

questions.question: Where is carbon found?
questions.fact: Carbon is found in all organic macromolecules.

questions.question: Along with nitrogen, what is one of the main ingredients in artificial fertilizers used in agriculture?
